params.name: Tune
params.desc: Intensity of initial pitch sweep envelope

params.name: Pitch
params.desc: Base oscillator frequency for the kick

params.name: Harmonics
params.desc: Shapes sine toward more harmonic content

params.name: Pulse
params.desc: Level of the click pulse in the attack

params.name: Noise
params.desc: Level of noise in the attack

params.name: Attack
params.desc: Scales the mixed pulse and noise attack

params.name: Gate Time
params.desc: Gate length for analog trigger circuit

params.name: Volume
params.desc: Main output level; velocity scales up to this level

params.name: LFO Sync
params.desc: LFO free run or retrigger on note

params.name: LFO Intensity
params.desc: Amount of LFO modulation applied to pitch

params.name: LFO Rate
params.desc: LFO speed in BPM or MIDI clock synced at lowest value

params.name: LFO One Shot
params.desc: Run one cycle as extra envelope
